result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: a strange dark bar overlapping the bottom navigation icons, truncated restaurant/category labels at the right edge, and a bottom navigation lacking labels and clear active state.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a long dark horizontal line/bar stretches from the search icon to the receipt/orders icon, overlapping both icons. It looks like a rendering artifact or misplaced element (possibly a mispositioned home-indicator or progress bar) rather than intentional design.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the stray bar element; if it is the device home indicator, it should be centered below the nav icons, not overlapping them.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' shows a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...') because the card is clipped at the screen edge without an ellipsis or peek affordance styling.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel clearly peeks the next card and truncate names with an ellipsis, or size cards so names fit within visible bounds.

issues.description: A category chip at the far right of the filter row (after 'Healthy') is cut off with no visible label, appearing as an empty gray sliver.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/scroll padding so partially visible chips still show part of their label, signaling horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels and only the home icon appears highlighted; the search and orders icons are obscured, making the nav hard to interpret.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each nav icon and a clear active-state indicator to improve clarity and accessibility.
